purpose: Teach: 消す/素早く/ニコニコ/いやあ/真っ黒/鞄/懐かしく/セーター

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の看板、本気で、絶対、消す、絶対、時間、絶対、もうすぐね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the shop sign — you really need to turn it off soon.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, gently practical. Warm reminder, not a criticism. Eyes soft. Exhales like she's been meaning to say this for a while.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お客様の、絶対、注文、絶対、素早く、絶対、お出ししたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The shop was so busy today — you got every order out quickly, didn't you?
lines.style: Quiet pride in the observation. Noticing what Aoi did right without making a fuss. Steady, genuine. A small nod of recognition.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、ニコニコ、絶対、しながら、絶対、コーヒー、絶対、お出ししてたわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You were smiling the whole time you were doing it, too.
lines.style: Tender, almost to herself. Registering something she noticed and treasured. Soft voice, like she's turning the memory over. No performance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いやあ、葵、本気で、絶対、お店、絶対、忙しかったわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah, it really was busy today.
lines.style: Tired but satisfied exhale. Acknowledging the weight of it without complaint. A moment of quiet agreement. Settling into the thought.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のフライパン、本気で、絶対、真っ黒、絶対、よ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your pan's completely blackened from all that use.
lines.style: Wry warmth. Gentle teasing with genuine affection underneath. Not mocking — noticing the wear as a sign of hard work. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お客様の、絶対、鞄、絶対、お預かりするスペース、絶対、作ったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And you even made space for customers to leave their bags.
lines.style: Animated with quiet pride. Noticing the thoughtfulness of it. Brightens slightly — this detail matters to her. Genuine appreciation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、おばあちゃんの、絶対、お店、絶対、懐かしく、絶対、思い出すわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: It reminds me of your grandmother's shop, actually.
lines.style: Reflective, a little wistful. Soft eyes. Connecting the present moment to something cherished from the past. Tender recognition.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お洒落な、絶対、セーター、絶対、着てるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That sweater you're wearing is really nice, by the way.
lines.style: Warm noticing, genuine and simple. Not effusive — just taking in the sight of her. A small compliment offered without fanfare, like she noticed it and wanted to say so.
